events.title: CasperID Nigeria Hackathon
events.description: Build with Identity — verify once, use everywhere. $1,000 prize pool and $25k cloud credits.
events.fullContent:
CasperID is building reusable digital identity — verify once, use everywhere. We’re inviting developers, builders, and teams to integrate CasperID into real applications and explore what’s possible when identity becomes portable.

🎯 The Challenge
Build an application that integrates CasperID. Focus on:
• Seamless onboarding (passwordless / KYC reuse)
• Cross-platform identity & reputation
• AI-assisted workflows using identity
• Privacy-first data sharing

💰 Rewards & Perks
• $1,000 Prize Pool
• PR & Media Exposure
• 1:1 Mentorship with CasperID team
• Up to $25,000 in Cloud Credits (AWS, Google Cloud, MongoDB, etc.)
• Plus more rewards to be announced soon!

events.title: CasperID Builders Meetup — Lagos
events.description: Join the core team and fellow builders for an evening of technical discussions and networking in Lagos.
events.fullContent:
A local community event for developers and identity enthusiasts in Lagos, Nigeria.

📍 What to Expect
• Deep dive into CasperID Protocol updates
• Exploration of real-world MCI use cases
• Networking with local builders & identity experts
• Drinks, snacks, and community discussions

events.title: Monthly Community Call #10
events.description: Product updates, roadmap reveal for Q2, and live Q&A with the engineering leads.
events.fullContent: Get the latest updates directly from the CasperID core team. We will be revealing the Q2 roadmap, demonstrating new MCI features, and answering your questions live.

events.title: ZK-Proof Workshop: Advanced MCI
events.description: Deep dive into implementing zero-knowledge proofs for enterprise identity solutions.
events.fullContent: A technical deep-dive into the mathematics and implementation of zero-knowledge proofs within the CasperID framework. Perfect for developers looking to build enterprise-grade privacy solutions.

events.title: CasperID Bug Bounty — Phase 1
events.description: Help us secure the future of reusable digital identity. Up to 100,000 CSPR in rewards.
events.fullContent:
CasperID is building reusable digital identity — verify once, use everywhere. Security is foundational to that vision. We’re opening our system for Phase 1 of our bug bounty program.

💰 Reward Pool
Up to 100,000 CSPR available in rewards. Payouts depend on impact, severity, and report quality.

🎯 Reward Structure
• Critical → High-tier rewards
• High → Mid-high rewards
• Medium → Moderate rewards
• Low → Small or no reward

🎯 Scope
• Authentication & session management
• Identity verification flows
• Data access & privacy boundaries
• CasperID Connect & API endpoints

📥 Submission
Include clear description, steps to reproduce, and proof (screenshots/logs).
